name: ρ ≥ 1 has no steady state, and the tool says so against the input that caused it

expect.message: At 1200 arrivals/s and 1 ms of service, one server can handle 1000/s. The queue never drains, so there is no steady state to report. Lower the arrival rate or speed up service.
